title: celsia brassicifolia
intro: Celsia brassicifolia, commonly known as Khat or Kat, is a flowering plant native to the Horn of Africa and the Arabian Peninsula. This plant is known for its health benefits, including reducing fatigue and improving cognitive function, due to its stimulant properties. The therapeutic actions of Celsia brassicifolia include acting as a mild central nervous system stimulant, increasing alertness, and reducing appetite. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, primarily cathinone and cathine, which are responsible for its stimulant effects.
